statement: GPT-5.6 Luna xhigh under the exact structured-owner-duty Codex 0.147.0 realization may derive one declared stats surface from exact admitted receipts without inventing metrics or acceptance meaning, but this remains a real-work canary hypothesis until an owner-reviewed stats duty demonstrates the role.

conditions: the stats owner, source receipts, compatibility contract, derivation and named outputs are explicit
the actor derives declared measurements rather than inventing metrics or proof meaning
the work runs in an isolated projection with effects bounded by the mandate
the result returns to the stats owner for compatibility and source-coverage review
the exact Codex 0.147.0 realization passes the live catalog check
the bound abyss-stack external actor runtime is artifact-admitted before launch
usage is counted from runtime receipts and never becomes a caller-authored execution budget
exclusions: inventing an owner metric, measurement ABI, threshold or acceptance rule
issuing eval verdicts, model-fit conclusions or owner acceptance
silently repairing missing or incompatible source receipts
autonomous commit, push, merge, publication or undelegated external effect
treating a generated summary as source truth
inferring closed-model internal geometry or training lineage from behavior
